title: Add read-only Charmbracelet terminal UI
description: Implemented md tui using Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss, and Glamour. Read-only task cards use the web dark palette and group in progress, ready, then not ready, with priority/ID sorting and closed/deleted tasks hidden. Includes search, responsive Markdown detail panes, keyboard/mouse scrolling, and revision-based local refresh. Verified with go test ./..., focused responsive/navigation/readiness tests, go install from cmd/md, and an installed-command terminal smoke test.
